scope: Seven newly applied dictionary/candidate source files: all eleven explicit methods/properties and five primary record declarations. No existing decoder modification, material normalization, dispatch or Shared change. Historical receipts are retained.

hashConvention.source: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after CRLF/CR to LF normalization; no trimming.
hashConvention.declaration: Exact Tree-sitter declaration byte span; excludes preceding XML comments and trailing whitespace.
hashConvention.signature: Declaration start through block/arrow-expression/accessor-list start, with trailing whitespace removed; bodyless record retains its full declaration.
hashConvention.body: Exact block, arrow-expression or accessor-list byte span.

variables.B: Encoded complete TXD root bytes, limited explicitly by caller before copy.
variables.C: Total actual direct chunk headers at the root and within native occurrences; fixed structural depth.
variables.Cn: Actual direct children of one native occurrence.
variables.Cparent: Actual complete child headers in the selected parent.
variables.R: Actual native occurrences; validated equal to low16 declaration, so R <=65535.
variables.J: Structural children matching a required type, J <= Cparent.
variables.P: Total logical texels in selected admitted authored mip levels.

primaryRecordDeclarations.name: RwPspTextureDictionary
primaryRecordDeclarations.primaryConstructorSpaceBound: O(1) reference/value-field assignment; no payload or collection copy.
primaryRecordDeclarations.review: Compiler-synthesized equality, printing, cloning and positional accessors are not individually reviewed or used to establish source identity; complete record declaration is hashed.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionary.FindExactName
callables.timeBound: O(R * min(L,64) + R); L is query length. Ordinal string comparison first checks lengths.
callables.spaceBound: O(K) matching-reference array and read-only wrapper; K <= R.
callables.review: One exact-name scan and one unresolved-name scan. Neither collapses duplicate occurrences nor searches another dictionary. Any uninterpretable source name prevents a conclusive Missing/Unique/Ambiguous result. No hash table or collision assumption.

primaryRecordDeclarations.review: Compiler-synthesized equality, printing, cloning and positional accessors are not individually reviewed or used to establish source identity; complete record declaration is hashed.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionaryRaster.TryDecode
callables.timeBound: O(1) on admission decline; O(Q^2 + P) on existing decoder invocation, Q=12 fixed.
callables.spaceBound: O(4*P + M) newly owned decoded pixels/levels plus decoder overhead. Retains existing encoded source; does not copy it.
callables.review: Negative budget throws. Existing DecodeRestriction declines before decoder. Long multiplication 8 * body length cannot overflow for an int-length memory. For supported formats total logical RGBA bytes <= this conservative bound. Decoder validates exact inferred chain and returns all authored levels; mutable arrays are fresh per call, not claimed immutable.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionaryReader.TryRead
callables.timeBound: O(B + C) including the source copy and structural/name review; source-limit and root checks are O(1), source identity whitespace check O(I).
callables.spaceBound: O(B + C) total owned root and metadata; failed post-copy validation may transiently retain the bounded copy until collection.
callables.review: Explicit encoded-byte budget, nonnegative origin bounds, long overflow guard and exact root type/end precede ToArray. Only InvalidDataException becomes a structural decline; resource exhaustion and programming errors propagate. Source identity/provenance is supplied by caller, not independently authenticated.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionaryReader.ReadOwned
callables.timeBound: O(Cd + sum(Cn) + R*64), equivalently O(C + R) for fixed 64-byte names.
callables.spaceBound: O(C + R) metadata/reference collections and diagnostics, in addition to already-owned B bytes.
callables.review: Complete child tiling and unique required Struct/Extension are validated; Struct body must be four bytes. Actual native children are enumerated before comparing low16 count and allocating raster array. No allocation follows an untrusted declared count. Unknown outer metadata/children preserves structure but restricts every selected decode.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionaryReader.ReadRaster
callables.spaceBound: O(Cn + 64) retained child metadata and bounded name/diagnostics; payloads are source slices.
callables.review: Complete native stream and unique required children precede fixed-name slicing. Header end arithmetic is bounded by owned source. Name field is retained intact; NUL-terminated Latin-1 is bijective on represented bytes. Truncated/unterminated names stay unresolved. Unknown metadata/opaque children restrict this occurrence, never remove it.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionaryReader.Children
callables.spaceBound: O(Cparent) chunk records and list backing storage; byte ranges are zero-copy slices.
callables.review: Every successful RwChunk header advances at least 12 bytes. The loop rejects any malformed tail and cannot accept a partial list. Depth is fixed at root/native; unknown/plugin contents are opaque, not recursively expanded. Inherited 0x1300 correction remains explicit follow-up.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionaryReader.Single
callables.review: Requires exactly one structural child. Repeated linear passes are a fixed number per root/native and do not create quadratic traversal. Duplicate metadata does not silently elect a winner.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionaryReader.InspectOpaque
callables.spaceBound: O(U) diagnostic strings; offsets/ordinals have fixed-width integer formatting and scope is internally constructed.
callables.review: One scan records unknown direct chunks and nonempty extensions. Root permits native children; native scope does not. A root restriction covers all its rasters; a native restriction covers only that occurrence. Opaque body bytes are retained without interpretation or allocation proportional to their claimed contents.

callables.name: RwPspTextureDictionaryReader.Require
callables.spaceBound: O(1) on success; one exception on failure.
callables.review: Does not swallow resource failures or arbitrary exceptions; TryRead catches only the structural InvalidDataException.

primaryRecordDeclarations.name: RwPspTextureCandidates
primaryRecordDeclarations.primaryConstructorSpaceBound: O(1) reference/value-field assignment; no payload or collection copy.
primaryRecordDeclarations.review: Compiler-synthesized equality, printing, cloning and positional accessors are not individually reviewed or used to establish source identity; complete record declaration is hashed.

callables.name: RwPspTextureCandidates.Status
callables.review: IncompleteNames takes precedence over known-candidate count. Reader constructs a read-only array-backed occurrence collection, whose Count is constant-time. Unique does not assert pixel/material support.

resourceBounds.structuralInput: One bounded owned root copy; explicit source limit and root/occurrence checks happen first. Origin strings are retained references, not copied. The reader does not perform archive I/O.
resourceBounds.counts: Lists and arrays grow from complete actual child headers. Native allocation occurs only after comparing actual occurrences against the 16-bit declared count. At least 12 encoded bytes back every traversed chunk record; nesting depth is fixed, with no recursive opaque-plugin expansion.
resourceBounds.pixelAdmission: Selected decoding only. Before allocation, 8 * Struct body length (long arithmetic) must fit caller maxDecodedBytes. For inherited supported formats, 4*P <= 8*encoded body bytes. The decoder also retains its 4096 dimension and 12-level limits.
resourceBounds.memoryMeaning: The RGBA limit is deliberately conservative and bounds decoded pixels, not total managed process memory, temporary list capacities, source copy or collection/diagnostic overhead.
resourceBounds.cancellation: No reader or selected decoder cancellation parameter is introduced. Operations are synchronous under explicit caller byte budgets; future source adapters must own lifetime/cancellation around them.
resourceBounds.dictionaryHashing: No hash-based dictionary is used in this slice; exact candidate and structural searches are linear. No average-case collision assumption is required.

behaviorReview: Complete structural failure declines the selected dictionary; no truncated success is returned. Unsupported semantic layouts retain exact source bytes and occurrence identity.
Unknown observed library/upper-word combinations or opaque dictionary children restrict all selected decoding in that root. Corresponding native restrictions apply only to the occurrence.
Exact Latin-1 names, case and duplicate ordinals survive. Incomplete names preserve known matches without a false Missing/Unique outcome. No cross-dictionary fallback or first/last election exists.

Caller source/opening identity and entry/resource location remain caller authority. The reader validates arithmetic containment but does not authenticate provenance against VFS or infer dependency semantics.
Fresh selected decode returns every admitted authored mip. Existing pixel arrays remain mutable; source-buffer independence is not deep immutability.
No sampler, alpha/culling, lighting, coordinate policy, material binding, normalized scene, export or viewer route is supplied.

verification.method: Read-only source/API and independent artifact review, Tree-sitter callable extraction/hashing, bounded original-byte fixture review. No .NET build/test or rendering was executed by this reviewer for this slice. Root coordinated compilation was running when the receipt was written.
verification.retailOracle: Existing bounded original 2007-1-11 Hub_1 entry ordinal87, archive offset98032192, length1989324. Dictionary resource0 at entry584, length456408, 64 native occurrences, word0x00090040. ob_Rock2 ordinal21; native/Struct headers relative124652/124664. Existing eight independent RGBA hashes and raw identities are reused through selected decoding and source overwrite; no new private payload copy.
verification.artifactIndependentReview: Exact frozen patch5fc25ff3 independently checked for applicability, source/API correctness, origin bounds, complete child tiling, unknown semantics and candidate completeness. No compiled acceptance claimed.

limits: This source-hashed review is not performance measurement, whole-pack decoding acceptance, a Windows/portable execution receipt or release acceptance.
Synthetic and one original-raster checks do not establish PSP normalized material/render/export fidelity.
Source-copy ownership and ReadOnlyMemory exposure do not promise adversarial deep immutability of internal .NET records or decoded byte arrays.

followUps.detail: Existing helper adjusts sizes and can clamp an undersized declaration. This new reader deliberately reuses it; raw headers retain the original size word. A stricter format policy requires separately reviewed source evidence, not a silent change here.

The existing 12-level inference limit declines a full 4096-to-1 thirteen-level square chain, and encoded-length inference does not by itself prove every repeated 1x1 level was authored. This slice retains existing decoder admission.

Prove selected source lifetime, dependency scope, coordinate convention and PSP sampler/alpha/culling/lighting semantics before material normalization or production dispatch. Names, upper word9 and observed raw0x11102 do not supply these semantics.
